from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Define Title and Lecture Lines
        title_text = "The Core: Deriving Bayes' Theorem"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Bayes' Theorem allows us to flip conditional probabilities.",
            "We relate P(A given B) to P(B given A. )",
            "This formula helps us update beliefs with new evidence.",
            "It combines our prior knowledge with new likelihood data.",
            "P(A|B) equals P(B|A) times P(A) divided by P(B)."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)

        # Color constants
        WHITE_C = "#FFFFFF"
        YELLOW_C = "#FFFF00"
        GREEN_C = "#00FF00"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display the equation P(A and B) = P(A|B) * P(B) in the center (#FFFFFF).
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE_C)
        eq1 = MathTex("P(A \\cap B)", "=", "P(A|B)P(B)", color=WHITE_C)
        self.place_in_area(eq1, "B1", "B6", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(eq1))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Below it, display the symmetric equation P(A and B) = P(B|A) * P(A) (#FFFFFF).
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE_C)
        eq2 = MathTex("P(A \\cap B)", "=", "P(B|A)P(A)", color=WHITE_C)
        self.place_in_area(eq2, "C1", "C6", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(eq2))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Animate an equals sign between P(A|B) * P(B) and P(B|A) * P(A), highlighting both terms in yellow (#FFFF00).
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW_C)
        
        # Define the combined equation structure
        combined_eq_mid = MathTex("P(A|B)P(B)", "=", "P(B|A)P(A)", color=YELLOW_C)
        self.place_in_area(combined_eq_mid, "D1", "D6", scale_factor=1.0)

        # Animate the transition and the equality sign
        self.play(
            eq1[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW_C),
            eq2[2].animate.set_color(YELLOW_C),
            ReplacementTransform(eq1[2].copy(), combined_eq_mid[0]),
            ReplacementTransform(eq2[2].copy(), combined_eq_mid[2]),
            Write(combined_eq_mid[1]),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Fade out the shared P(A and B) part and move the right side terms to form a single equality.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE_C)
        
        # Center the combined equality in the visual field
        final_combined_eq = MathTex("P(A|B)P(B)", "=", "P(B|A)P(A)", color=YELLOW_C)
        self.place_in_area(final_combined_eq, "C1", "C6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(eq1),
            FadeOut(eq2),
            ReplacementTransform(combined_eq_mid, final_combined_eq)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Rearrange terms to show P(A|B) = [P(B|A)P(A)] / P(B), putting a bright box (#00FF00) around it.
        self.lecture[4].set_color(GREEN_C)
        
        # Create final Bayes' Theorem formula
        bayes_formula = MathTex("P(A|B)", "=", "\\frac{P(B|A) P(A)}{P(B)}", color=GREEN_C)
        self.place_in_area(bayes_formula, "D1", "E6", scale_factor=1.2)
        
        # Highlight with a box
        box = SurroundingRectangle(bayes_formula, color=GREEN_C, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(final_combined_eq, bayes_formula)
        )
        self.play(Create(box))
        self.wait(3)
